notes.title: Game Development Update
notes.notes:
Warning! To cover up the scandal of illegal experiments, the ACX Group has fully upgraded its defense deployment: it has not only intensively added mechanical sentries and mechanical hounds in various areas, with patrol ranges covering key exploration points; but also installed new homing missile systems in the Trial Arena. The lock-on attack mode will greatly raise the challenge difficulty!
New Awakened Warrior Online: The Veteran Hunter
The long-range combat ace "The Veteran Hunter" officially joins the battle with his loyal hunting dog!

He excels at precise sniping and battlefield suppression, and also comes with bow and arrow equipment suitable for multiple scenarios.
New Arsenal: Targeted Countermeasures Against Mechanical Enemies
"Annihilator" Series Magnetic Storm Rifles

Core highlight: "Multi-target Strike" — a single attack can penetrate multiple enemies, doubling your efficiency against ACX cluster sentries;

Hunter-exclusive Multi-functional Bows and Arrows

Supports "compatibility with various types of ammunition". Whether it's Armor-Piercing Arrows, Incendiary Arrows, or Explosive Arrows, you can switch them as needed to adapt to different combat requirements;

Secret Weapons of Eastern Ninjas

Mysterious ninjas also bring portable shurikens (throwing stars) and kunais (daggers).
50+ New Items: Full Tactical Support
Exclusive Support from Anonymous Drone Experts

2 types of auxiliary drones that can continuously release "Boost Rays" in the air (including attack power boost, defense boost, HP Recovery Buff, etc.) to provide full-course bonuses;

New Practical Equipment from Arms Dealers

Flash Grenades (instantly blind a large range of units)

Various EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse) Weapons (directly paralyze the movement of enemy machinery, creating opportunities for raids)
There are also dozens of items to be unlocked — ranging from resource supplies to tactical support, they will boost your survival and combat abilities across the board!
